title: On positivity of CM line bundles on the moduli space of klt good minimal models with $κ=1$
summary: We study the positivity of CM line bundles on the coarse moduli space of Kawamata log terminal (klt) good minimal models with Kodaira dimension one. We prove that the seminormalization of the moduli space is quasi-projective under a mild assumption on the general fibers of good minimal models. Moreover, we show that the CM line bundle becomes ample after normalization.
